description: Header file defining the CompositorNativeWindow11 class and RoHelper class for Windows UI Composition integration in ANGLE's D3D11 renderer, including methods for window management, swap chain creation, and Windows Runtime interop.

classes.name: RoHelper
classes.description: Helper class for Windows Runtime (WinRT) interop, managing string operations, activation factories, and dispatcher queue control.

classes.name: CompositorNativeWindow11
classes.description: Implementation of NativeWindow11 using Windows.UI.Composition APIs for window and swap chain management in Win32 and WinRT contexts.

methods.name: CompositorNativeWindow11
methods.description: Constructor initializing the window with optional alpha transparency.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the native window and composition resources.

methods.name: getClientRect
methods.description: Retrieves the client rectangle of the window.

methods.name: isIconic
methods.description: Checks if the window is minimized.

methods.name: createSwapChain
methods.description: Creates a Direct3D swap chain for rendering.

methods.name: commitChange
methods.description: Commits any pending changes to the window surface.

methods.name: IsValidNativeWindow
methods.description: Static method to validate a native window handle.

methods.name: IsSupportedWinRelease
methods.description: Static method to check if the Windows release supports required features.

methods.name: IsSpriteVisual
methods.description: Static method to determine if the window uses a sprite visual.
